key_idea: The proof uses a broad-narrow analysis and induction on scales, applying multilinear refined Strichartz estimates to the broad case and l^2 decoupling to the narrow case.
reason: While the conceptual skeleton of the broad-narrow dichotomy is clear, the argument is buried under the heavy machinery of modern restriction theory. The dense bookkeeping, multiple parameters, and repeated dyadic pigeonholing obscure the geometric reasons for why the bounds ultimately close.
recognized: Xiumin Du and Ruixiang Zhang, Sharp L^2 estimates of the Schrödinger maximal function in higher dimensions (2019)
